caveats: School assignment regions are approximate parcel-derived SLPS Focus lookup regions, not official boundary files.
School area comparisons are ACS resident estimates; assignment-region values are area-weighted Census tract overlaps and assume residents are uniformly distributed within each tract.
School metrics mix 2025 enrollment, PAR attendance proxy values, 2024-25 NCES counts, and Future Ready planning data.

Public and charter teacher FTE and student/teacher ratio values come from NCES CCD/EDGE Public School Administrative Data 2024-25; private values come from NCES PSS private-school detail pages for 2023-24.
Public/charter and private student/teacher ratios are comparable only at a high level because they come from different NCES source families and years.
DESE building-level finance values are published current expenditures per September membership; this source does not identify school-level salary-only totals.
Public and charter enrollment growth uses up to the latest 10 usable annual NCES CCD/EDGE school-site membership records; bar heights are scaled to each school's displayed-window maximum.
Private-school enrollment growth uses PPIN-keyed NCES PSS history and requires at least two usable survey-year enrollment points.

Enrollment trends are classified by least-squares slope when at least two annual records are available, normalized by each school's displayed-window maximum; absolute normalized slope below 2% per year is steady.
Charter schools are NCES CCD public-school campus records. Their enrollment, race, and direct-certification values describe enrolled students at the school site, not ACS resident enrollment.

Charter MAP/IEP displays are shown only for campuses with a high-confidence NCES-to-DESE building crosswalk and usable school-level MAP rows; ambiguous, unmatched, suppressed, or non-tested campuses remain unavailable.
Future Ready closure planning, SLPS assignment-region comparisons, PAR attendance, building capacity, and PTO research are SLPS-only unless a record explicitly marks those metrics available.
PTO activity is curated public-evidence research, not an SLPS-maintained administrative field; unknown means not yet researched.
Missouri Assessment Program values describe MAP-tested students by content, grade, group, and metric; subgroup n_size values are not full-school enrollment counts.
MAP missing or suppressed percentage cells are omitted from charts, and reported missingness is displayed as its own assessment category.
School coordinates are geocoder-derived for source rows with addresses; rows without source addresses are omitted from the map.
City demographics are ACS estimates; home value is Zillow ZHVI typical home value, not an arithmetic average.
Public/private school enrollment layers are ACS residence-based estimates for ages 5-17 by Census geography, not SLPS-operated enrollment or school-site totals.
School-age race layers are ACS resident estimates for ages 5-17; White is non-Hispanic White alone, Black is Black alone, and Other is a residual estimate.

Private schools are plotted from NCES EDGE as a separate layer and are not included in SLPS school totals, closure plans, assignment regions, capacity, attendance, direct-certification, MAP, IEP, or PTO summaries.
Private-school site enrollment, race, teacher, grade, type, affiliation, and schedule fields come from matched NCES PSS private-school detail pages when available.
Private-school area context is ACS residence-based tract data around the campus; it is not school-site enrollment, poverty, or student race.

SLPS enrollment fields are internal SLPS residence/enrollment aggregates by Census Block Group; 2020 population fields are Census counts. Enrollment-per-school-age comparisons mix source concepts and years.

schools.dese_building_directory_source: Missouri DESE School Directory Building List
schools.dese_building_directory_note: DESE says School Directory data are refreshed weekly. This cache may be replaced with a Building List export; when absent, the builder seeds a conservative school-code cache from the public 2025 MEDE school-level MAP rows.
schools.map_2025_note: MAP assessment data uses tested-student denominators; subgroup n_size values are not full-school enrollment counts.
schools.building_expenditures_source_label: Missouri DESE Building Level Per Pupil Expenditures 2025

daa_labs.caveat: SLPS enrollment fields are internal SLPS residence/enrollment aggregates by Census Block Group; 2020 population fields are Census counts. Enrollment-per-school-age comparisons mix source concepts and years.

demographics_metadata.race_categories: Mutually exclusive B03002 categories. Other equals total minus non-Hispanic White alone and non-Hispanic Black alone, so it includes Hispanic residents and all other race groups.
demographics_metadata.school_age_race_definition: Resident ages 5-17 by tract from ACS B01001H and B01001B. White is non-Hispanic White alone; Black is Black alone and may overlap Hispanic origin; Other/residual equals total school-age residents minus those two estimates.
demographics_metadata.school_enrollment_definition: Resident ages 5-17 enrolled in public or private school from ACS B14003. Public-school enrollment is not SLPS-operated enrollment and may include charter or other public-school enrollment captured by ACS.
demographics_metadata.school_enrollment_moe_note: Native ACS public/private school enrollment MOEs are root-sum-of-squares from component B14003 MOEs. Enrollment fields are left on the native Census geography rather than area-weighted to ZIPs.
demographics_metadata.migration_definition: Resident ages 5-17 by residence one year ago from ACS B07001 rows. The displayed migration waffle uses this county as same house plus moved within same county, different county as moved from a different county within Missouri, and different state as moved from a different state. Moved from abroad is fetched for source clarity but excluded from the three-bucket waffle.
demographics_metadata.migration_moe_note: This-county migration MOE is root-sum-of-squares from the same-house and moved-within-same-county B07001 MOEs.
demographics_metadata.zillow_label: Typical home value (ZHVI), not arithmetic average home value.
demographics_metadata.zip_geometry_note: ZIP geometries are clipped to the St. Louis City boundary; ZHVI remains ZIP-level.
demographics_metadata.tornado_damage_note: NWS damage points are survey observations, not a complete parcel or building damage census.
